milestones.name: Working ingestion pipeline
milestones.outcome: Users can upload a PDF and receive extracted text output.

milestones.name: User management and access control
milestones.outcome: Users can register, log in, and manage document permissions.

milestones.name: Search and retrieval
milestones.outcome: Users can search uploaded documents and view relevant excerpts.

epics.title: Implement PDF document ingestion pipeline
epics.summary: Enables users to upload PDF documents and receive structured text output.
epics.objective: Enables users to upload PDF documents and receive structured text output.

inScope: Storage of extracted text in Postgres
outOfScope: Batch upload of multiple PDFs — deferred to EP-004

acceptanceCriteria: User can upload a PDF up to 100MB and receive extracted text within 10s
Extracted text is stored in Postgres with document metadata
Invalid file types are rejected with a clear error message
epics.notes: Requires Postgres schema to be created first (EP-002).

epics.title: Set up database schema and migrations
epics.summary: Creates the database schema for documents, users, and permissions.
epics.objective: Provides the data storage layer for all document and user data.

inScope: Postgres schema for documents, users, permissions

acceptanceCriteria: Database schema is versioned and can be applied via Alembic
Document metadata table supports PDF upload workflow
Schema migration can be rolled back safely

epics.title: Implement user registration and authentication
epics.summary: Users can register accounts and authenticate via email/password.
epics.objective: Provides user registration and authentication for the platform.

inScope: User registration with email and password

acceptanceCriteria: User can register with email and password
User can log in and receive a valid JWT token
Password is hashed with bcrypt before storage

epics.title: Implement document permission management
epics.summary: Users can set read/write permissions on their uploaded documents.
epics.objective: Enables document owners to control who can access their documents.

inScope: Owner can set document to private or shared
Shared users can view but not modify documents
Permission checks enforced at API level
outOfScope: Role-based access control (RBAC) — out of scope
Audit logging for permission changes — deferred

acceptanceCriteria: Document owner can set a document to private or shared
Shared users can view documents but cannot modify them
Permission checks are enforced at the API level

epics.title: Implement full-text search on extracted documents
epics.summary: Users can search uploaded documents and view relevant excerpts.
epics.objective: Enables users to search through their uploaded documents using full-text search.

inScope: Full-text search on extracted document text
Search results show document title and relevant excerpts
Search is limited to user's own documents

acceptanceCriteria: User can search across all their uploaded documents
Search results include document title and relevant excerpts
Search is limited to documents owned by the authenticated user
